description: This is a unit test class for the ThemeService in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing theme-related functionalities such as showing social media images, retrieving theme variables, and fetching theme images.

classes.name: ThemeServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies the behavior of the ThemeService related to theme images and variables in different scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures by loading theme configuration data from a YAML file before each test.

methods.name: testShowSocialMediaImages
methods.description: Tests the visibility of social media images based on theme conditions, checking both custom and default themes, including caching behavior.

methods.name: testGetCurrentThemeVariables
methods.description: Verifies the retrieval and caching of current theme CSS variables for both custom and default themes.

methods.name: testGetImageETagWithNullImage
methods.description: Checks that the method returns null when requesting an ETag for a non-existent image.

methods.name: testGetImage
methods.description: Validates that the correct image filename is returned for a given image identifier.

methods.name: testGetImageWithNullImage
methods.description: Ensures that requesting an image that does not exist returns null.
